evidence.summary: China’s Ministry of Science and Technology approved the centre in November 2017 as one of six national research centres, built on a pilot national laboratory at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC); the US Entity List gives its address on USTC’s Hefei campus. The university’s newspaper says its research is led by quantum control and quantum information, and that the laboratory led the development of the Micius quantum science satellite and the Beijing–Shanghai quantum communication line.
